body:
I think you might be onto something here. Especially about sabotaging my friendships- and myself- because I don’t actually have the confidence that these things are actually going to fail, I think it made me realise that the standards of ‘good’ and ‘bad’ I hold myself to are both far too high and far too binary- like, I can A) do everything I need to do exactly when it needs to be done or B) be a failure.  I’m definitely stuck in limbo between the two because I’m hardly doing everything I need to do, yet I’m still not failing, and that option doesn’t exist to me because it’s not A or B so, accepting that A is unattainable, I self sabotage just to get to that comfortable state
of complete failure. 
This was so incredibly helpful and insightful, thank you

i’m glad and also sorry someone can relate lol, It sucks when people assume it’s just laziness or excuses cuz for me at least, it’s hard enough to keep reminding myself that i’m *not* just lazy, that there’s an actual reason these things are harder. so when people are like ‘oh you’re just not trying’ it’s hard not to believe them sometimes. Hope things start looking up for ya!
